svg.title: A pocket-sized snow village — step 5: Tell a snowy village story
svg.desc: Look around your tiny village. Try one twig-roof cottage, a group of round sprig-topped houses, or a snow castle with a pebble courtyard. Connect their doors with branching paths. Imagine who lives there, photograph the scene and gather your decorations before warming up inside.
